text.A: **Þessi stefna gildir hvar sem þú ert.** Við fylgjum breskum persónuverndarlögum og, þar sem persónuverndarlög landsins sem þú býrð í gilda einnig, fylgjum við þeim líka.
text.B: **Athugasemdir um ofnæmi og mataræði.** Við komum þeim áleiðis til matarvagnsins ásamt pöntuninni þinni og notum þær ekki í neinum öðrum tilgangi. Við eyðum þeim, ásamt nafni þínu og samskiptaupplýsingum, 12 mánuðum eftir pöntunina (sjá 7. kafla).
text.C: **Flutningur milli landa.** Upplýsingar um aðgang þinn og pantanir eru geymdar og unnar í Bretlandi. Sumt er meðhöndlað utan þess: lestur matseðla og sjálfvirk svör á WhatsApp, sem nota þjónustu Google í Bandaríkjunum; afhending WhatsApp-skilaboða, sem Meta annast í Bandaríkjunum; greiðslur, sem Stripe annast í Bandaríkjunum; og tilkynningar, sem Apple og Google afhenda í Bandaríkjunum. Þegar upplýsingar fara frá Bretlandi byggist flutningurinn á breskum reglum um fullnægjandi vernd (UK adequacy regulations) eða á International Data Transfer Agreement eða Addendum og, þar sem lög lands þíns krefjast þess, á verndarráðstöfun sem þau lög viðurkenna. Þú getur óskað eftir upplýsingum frá okkur um þær verndarráðstafanir sem eiga við.
text.G:
[Notkunarskilmálar](/terms) okkar gilda í öllum löndum þar sem HatchGrab er notað. Í sumum löndum gilda viðbótarreglur. Á þessari síðu eru þær raktar, eitt land í einu.

Þegar einhver kaflanna hér að neðan á við um þig er hann hluti af Notkunarskilmálum okkar. Ef hann kveður á um annað en þau skjöl gildir þessi síða fyrir viðkomandi land.

Ef landið þitt er ekki tilgreint gilda engar viðbótarreglur: Notkunarskilmálarnir gilda eins og þeir eru orðaðir. [Persónuverndarstefna](/privacy) okkar er sú sama í öllum löndum.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We follow British data protection law and, where the data protection laws of the country you live in also apply, we follow them too.
back.B: **Notes about allergies and diet.** We pass them on to the food truck together with your order and use them for no other purpose. We delete them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: When data leave Britain, the transfer is based on British rules on adequate protection (UK adequacy regulations) or on the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum and, where the law of your country requires it, on a safeguard that that law recognises.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under British data protection law, and the law of the country you live in where it applies, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law where you live may give you these rights under other names, or additional rights. Those you have too. / **Making a request.** Send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We make sure the request is genuine before we respond to it. You can entrust someone else to make the request on your behalf and we do not discriminate against you for making a request. We reply within one month, or sooner if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may forward your request to that food truck, because it decides how information about your order is used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to review it by replying to our answer. / **Account deletion.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove the names, contact details and notes of its customers from the orders we keep. / **Marketing email.** We send marketing email only where the law where you live permits it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one states who it is from, our postal address and how you can decline further mailings. If you ask us to stop, we do so, at no cost to you and within 10 working days. Email about an order or your account is not marketing material. If we or a food truck offer order status notifications by text message, you get them only if you agree to it, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a privacy breach concerning your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will notify you and the data protection authority as quickly as possible where the law requires it, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Let us know first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would appreciate the chance to remedy the matter. You can also lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of the country where you live. In Britain that is the British data protection office (Information Commissioner's Office), at ico.org.uk or on phone 0303 123 1113.
